title: Outpatient clinic visit
description: Outpatient clinic visit is an appointment with your doctor in a medical office or clinic setting. These visits allow your doctor to assess your health, evaluate symptoms, perform exams, and discuss your medical care. You'll meet with your doctor, who will listen to your concerns and perform appropriate evaluations. Your doctor may order tests, perform physical exams, or discuss treatment options with you. Clinic visits may focus on managing chronic conditions, addressing acute problems, or preventive health maintenance. The complexity of your visit depends on the nature of your health concerns and how much evaluation and discussion is needed. Your doctor will explain findings and discuss next steps in your care during your visit. The cost of this procedure may vary depending on the complexity involved. Categories include low complexity (new or established), moderate complexity (new or established), and high complexity (new or established).
